s: Din mayim shellashin bahem hammatztza ubo l"d seipim: hammatztza sheadam okel kol yeme happesach en lashin otah ella bemayim tzonenin, abal lo beposherin, dehaynu kachamimut haroq, lepi shebbeqal tukal labo lide chimmutz kesheen hammayim tzonenin im lo yitassequ bizrizut yetera meod, veen anu bechezqat zerizin kol kak, lepikak aseru lanu chakamim lalush beposherin, veen tzarik lomar bechammin (abal berotechin haya muttar meiqqar haddin, ella shehaggeonim hechemiru veaseru, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"d):

Vaapillu bemayim tzonenin aseru chakamim lalush bahem bo bayyom shennishabu mehannahar o mehammayan, ella tzarik lehalinam qodem sheyyalush bahem. Vetaam lina zo, yesh omerim: lepi sheyyeme nisan adayin mimot hachorep hen, shehammayanot hen rotechin meat, lepikak tzarik letzannenam layla echad leachar shennitleshu mimmeqom retichatan, dehaynu leachar shennishabu mehammayan. Ume hanneharot sheenan nimshakin mimmayanot tzerikin gam ken tzinnun layla echad, lepi shehikka alehem chom hashshemesh bayyom venitchammemu meat:

Ulekattechilla yesh lizzaher leshooban qodem kenisat techillat hallayla, kede sheyyaabor alehem tzinnun kol hallayla leachar shennitleshu mimmeqom retichatan. Ubediabad sheabar usheaban leachar kenisat techillat hallayla — muttar lalush bahem lekattechilla lemachar leachar sheyyair hayyom im sheaban qodem chatzi hallayla, lepi sheiqqar tzinnun hallayla hu mechatzot ad ammud hashshachar, shebbekol shishsha shaot hallalu menashshebet ruach tzeponit. Abal qodem ammud hashshachar asur lalush bahen, apillu sheaban etmol qodem ammud hashshachar, shetztzarik sheyyaabru alehem leachar shennitleshu mimmeqom retichatan kol shishsha shaot shemmechatzot hallayla ad ammud hashshachar retzupin. Abal kesherotzeh lalush bahen lemachar leachar sheyyaaleh ammud hashshachar — rashshay leshooban hayyom bekol shaa sheyyirtzeh mehayyom, shehare yitztannenu kol hallayla. Umikkol maqom, iqqar hatztzinnun hu ballayla sheen sham chom hashshemesh, abal bayyom ap leachar shennitleshu mimmeqom retichatan enam mitztannenim kelal, shechom hashshemesh mechammeman:

Abal yesh omerim shettaam lina zo: lepi shebballayla kol me mayanot uneharot hen rotechin meat shehachamma mechammamtan tachat haqqarqa, teda, shebbaalot hashshachar atta roeh ashan al hanneharot. Lepikak, kesherotzeh lalush bahen tzarik shekkol hallayla yihyu telushin mimmeqom retichatan, dehaynu sheyyishabem techillat hallayla mammash. Veim sheaban leachar techillat hallayla — asur lalush bahen, shekkebar nitchammemu bitchillat hallayla. Abal hammayim shennishabu bitchillat hallayla mammash, ap shekkebar nitchammemu belel etmol, mikkol maqom kebar nitztannenu mechimmum zeh keshehayu mechubbarin bammayan yom tamim, shehammayanot hen tzonenim bayyom, lepi shehachamma geboha mehen, vehaqqarqa shettachtehen tzonenet umetzannantan:

Ulepi taam zeh, en lishob hammayim lelishat hammatztzot ella beben hashshemashot bilbad, sheqqodem ben hashshemashot adayin lo nitztannenu hammayim meretichatan shehayu rotechin ballayla heabar, shehare lo abar yom tamim missop layla heabar, veachar ben hashshemashot yesh lachosh shemma kebar hu achar techillat hallayla (sheen hakkol beqiin letzamtzem techillat hallayla mammash), ukebar nitchammemu hammayim meat, veen lahem taqqana lalush bahem apillu leachar kamma lelot, sheen tzinnun moil lammayim lepi sebara zo ella im ken nitztannenu bimchubbar laqqarqa yom tamim, veen hallina mosepet lahem od tzinnun. (Umah shehizkiru chakamim lina, hu kede lelammedenu shehallina bimchubbar laqqarqa hi haggoremet haissur, shebballayla hammayanot hen rotechin abal lo bayyom, umimmela nishma shetztzarik leshoobam beben hashshemashot, kede sheyyaabru alehem y"b shaot shel yom tamim bimchubbar laqqarqa, sheyyitztannenu meretichatan shehayu rotechin y"b shaot shel layla heabar):

Uleinyan pesaq halaka, lekattechilla yesh lehachamir kechomer b' hassebarot, dehaynu sheyyishaben beben hashshemashot, velo yalush bahen ad leachar sheyyair hayyom lemachar. Veim eno yodea lekavven lishob beben hashshemashot mammash — yaqdim meat lishob beshaa shebbari lo sheadayin lo abar kol orek ben hashshemashot (veshiur orek ben hashshemashot ayyen besiman rs"a). Veen lachosh lo shemma adayin hu yom gadol, shehare lepi sebara harishona muttar lishob lekattechilla beod hayyom gadol. Abal im hu choshesh shemma kebar abar kol ben hashshemashot ukebar hu achar hatchalat hallayla — lo yishab od, shehare ap lepi sebara harishona tzarik lishob lekattechilla behatchalat hallayla mammash. Ubediabad sheabar usheaban beod hayyom gadol — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, umuttar lalush bahen lemachar leachar sheheir hayyom. Veken im abar usheaban leachar techillat hallayla — muttar lalush bahem lemachar im nishabu qodem chatzot hallayla. Umikkol maqom, yesh lehamtin millalush bahem ad sheyyaabru alehem y"b shaot meet shennishabu, lepi sheyyesh omerim sheen hammayim mitztannenim meretichatan shehayu rotechin bimot haggeshamim ad sheyyaabru alehem y"b shaot meet shennitleshu mimmeqom retichatan:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla keshemmelinim hammayim, shello yelinem betok bet hachorep, velo becheder acher, ella bemaqom megulleh, kede sheyyitztannenu baavir haolam. Veim avir haolam hu cham — lo yelinem baavir ella bammartep, shehammartep hu qar bizman hachom (veim en lo martep — yannichem betok habbayit). Veim avir haolam hu qar — lo yannichem bammartep shehu cham bizman haqqor, ella yelinem baavir:

Ukeshemmelinam baavir — tzarik lizzaher lehaknisam tachat hattiqra o letok cheder meqoreh qodem zerichat hashshemesh, shello yitchammemu bechom hashshemesh. Veap beyom hamunnan ober chom hashshemesh derek heabim umechammem hammayim. Vaapillu hem mekussim, en hakkissuy megen alehem im yishtahu harbeh bachamma. Lepikak, yoter tob lehalinam tachat hattiqra, shemma yishkach lehaknisam qodem sheyyizrach hashshemesh. Umikkol maqom, im helinam baavir velo hiknisam qodem zerichat hashshemesh — muttar lalush bahem apillu zorcha hashshemesh alehem, im lo nishtahu sham ad kede sheyyuchammu hammayim bechom hashshemesh ella metzaan tzonenim:

Keshemmolik hammayim bayyom tachat avir haraqia, kegon shemmolikan min hammartep lebet hallisha, yesh lizzaher lekassotan bemappa im hu yom hamunnan, o shemmolikan bimqom zerichat hashshemesh, shello yitchammemu meat bechom hashshemesh. Veim molikan bikli zekukit — en moil mah shemmekasseh bemappa al gabbehem, ki chom hashshemesh ober derek dapnot hakkeli. (Vetzarik lekassot hammappa al haddepanot shekkeneged zerichat hashshemesh, veim hu yom hamunnan tzarik lekassot al kol haddepanot). Abal keshemmolik hammayim ballayla o beben hashshemashot, kegon bishat sheibatan mehannahar o mehammayan shemmolikan mishsham lebeto derek avir haraqia — en tzarik lekassoto kelal, shehare kebar shoqa hachamma velo yitchammemu od, ella shennahagu lekassotan shello yippol letokam shum debar chimmutz. Umittaam zeh nohagin lesannen hammayim bishat hashsheiba bebeged laban venaqi:

Muttar lishob mayim beben hashshemashot echad letzorek yamim harbeh. Veap shebbekol yom avir haolam hu cham mechom hashshemesh, ap al pi ken en hammayim shebbetok hakkeli mitchammemin, kevan shehem betok habbayit, sheen chom hashshemesh makkeh alehem. Umikkol maqom, bekol layla yannichem baavir tachat hattiqra. Veim avir haolam hu cham — yannichem bammartep, ben bayyom ben ballayla, ad hallisha:

Hannohagim leepot matztza shel mitzva belel t"v mittaam sheyyitbaer besiman tn"ch, im chal t"v beechad bashshabbat — tzerikim hem lishob hammayim beyom h' samuk lachasheka beben hashshemashot shel lel shishshi, shei epshar lahem lishob beben hashshemashot shel lel shabbat apillu mibbeer shebbechatzer, lepi sheasur lehakin mishshabbat leyom tob apillu bedabar sheen bo melaka asura, kemo shennitbaer besiman ty"v, uben hashshemashot sepeq shabbat hu:

Veim shakach velo shaab beben hashshemashot shel lel v' — yishab beyom v' samuk lachasheka qodem ben hashshemashot meat, sheyyesh lismok al haomerim shemmuttar lishob hammayim apillu beod hayyom gadol. Veim shakach velo sheaban qodem ben hashshemashot venizkar beben hashshemashot — yishab al yede nokri (apillu en bor bachatzero vetzarik leholikan derek reshut harabbim, sheamira lenokri hi shebut, ubeben hashshemashot lo gazeru al shebut bimqom mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"a). Veap shellekattechilla en lishob hammayim shel matztzot mitzva al yede nokri kemo sheyyitbaer, mikkol maqom kan shei epshar beinyan acher — hare zeh kediabad:

Veim yesh lo bebeto mayim sheubim mibbeod yom ap shello nishabu leshem mitzva — yiqqach otam lalush bahem, velo yomar lenokri sheyyishab lo od mayim acherim beben hashshemashot im tzarik leholikan derek reshut harabbim, shehaiqqar kehaomerim sheap hammayim shennishabu mibbeod yom kesherim lalush bahem lekattechilla, veim ken en kan mitzva kelal lishob od mayim:

Abal im en tzarik leholikan ella derek karmelit — yomar lenokri sheyyishab lo mayim vibiem ben hashshemashot, veal yiqqach hammayim shebbebeto shennishabu mibbeod yom. Veen tzarik lomar im yesh lo bor bachatzero, sheyyomar lenokri lishob lo beben hashshemashot, sheissur hattiltul bekarmelit, veken issur hakana mishshabbat leyom tob bedabar sheen bo melaka, enah ella shebut middibre soperim, ukesheomer lenokri laasot hare hu shebut dishbut, velo gazeru alayv beben hashshemashot ap shello letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besiman shm"t. Veim shakach beben hashshemashot velo amar lenokri lishob lo mayim — yiqqach hammayim sheubim shebbebeto shennishabu mibbeod yom ap shello nishabu leshem mitzva, kevan shei epshar beinyan acher:

Mi sheyyesh lo bebeto mayim sheubin sheshsheaban lelishat hammatztza venopla hattequpa ballayla o bayyom, o shemmet echad bishkunato, shetztzarik lishpok kol hammayim shebbashshekuna mippene chashash sakkana, ap al pi ken en tzarik lishpok mayim hallalu, shenneemar "shomer mitzva lo yeda dabar ra". Veim rotzeh lehachamir uleshopkam — hareshut beyado. Venakon laasot ken im epshar lo beqal limtzo mayim acherim shellanu, o sheepshar lo beqal lalush beyom acher bemayim acherim sheyyishab beben hashshemashot shellepanayv:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemayim sheshsheaban lelishat hammatztza sheenah shel mitzva, shehi qeroba lidbar hareshut, shehareshut beyado shello leekol matztza kol yeme happesach, lepikak rashshay lehachamir al atzmo uleshopkam. Abal hammayim shennishabu lelishat hammatztzot shel mitzva, ap im epshar lo limtzo mayim acherim umachamir al atzmo veshopekan — lo tob hu oseh, shennireh kimzalzel bemaamar hakkatub: "shomer mitzva lo yeda dabar ra". Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla qodem shehattequpa nopelet lo yismok al zeh, veyasim letoko barzel. Vetob lizzaher sheyyehe habbarzel naqi keen machat vekayyotze bah, shello yehe (meuma perur chametz mashshehu) dabuq babbarzel veyipparer mimmennu letok hammayim:

Vetob lizzaher shello lehashhot habbarzel betok hammayim, ella yotziennu miyyad leachar shennopla hattequpa, shehabbarzel mechammem meat et hammayim. Veken tob lizzaher liqshor habbarzel bechut o bimshicha verosh hashsheni shel hachut yihyeh chutz lammayim, kede sheyyukal leechoz bo lehotzi habbarzel min hammayim, velo yitztarek lehaknis yado letok hammayim lehotzio mishsham, shehayyad mechammemet meat et hammayim:

Yesh lizzaher lekattechilla shello lishob hammayim lelishat hammatztzot shel mitzva al yede nokri (velo al yede cheresh shoteh veqatan), lepi shemmakshire hammitzva hen kemitzva, vehallisha shel matztzat mitzva enah keshera ki im al yede yisrael (gadol ben daat) sheyyishmor otah mechimmutz leshem mitzva. Veap lelishat shear hammatztzot tob sheyyishab yisrael im epshar:

Nohagim shello lishob hammayim bikle cheres ella im ken hem chadashim, abal lo bishanim apillu hem shel pesach heabar, ella im ken hem metzuppim (ayyen besiman tn"a), shekkele cheres yeshanim sheenan metzuppin enan hiddur lemitzva, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tra"g, veen leshannot hamminhag. Abal bishar kol hakkelim apillu shel etz — en lehaqpid bahem im hem yeshanim. Ubilbad shello nishtammesh bahem ella bemayim bilbad, abal im haya bahem me perot (perush kol hammashqin chutz mimmayim niqra me perot leinyan zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b) — tob lizzaher shello lishob bo ella im ken higilo miqqodem, lepi shemme perot keshemmitareb meat mehem bemayim memaharin hammayim lehachmitz et haissa shennillosha bahem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b. Ulekattechilla tob lizzaher shello lishob bikli nechoshet vaapillu hu chadash, lepi shehannechoshet mechammem. Abal bediabad en lachosh. Vaapillu nishtahu hammayim betoko yamim harbeh — muttar lalush bahem:

Vaapillu lekattechilla nohagin hetter lalush bikli nechoshet, veen nizharin ella shello lishob bo mayim, shehammayim tzerikin tzinnun layla echad, ukeshehem bikli nechoshet enan mitztannenin kol kak kemo bishar kelim:

Nohagin sheen lashin hammatztzot shel mitzva bemayim shennishabu lelishat shear hammatztzot, ella shoeb mayim meyuchadim lelishat hammatztzot shel mitzva, veomerim bishat hashsheiba: "hareni shoeb leshem matztzat mitzva":

Lekattechilla yesh lishob min hanneharot im epshar lo velo min habbeerot, lepi shemme habbeerot bimot hachorep hem rotechim yoter mimme hanneharot (vime nisan mimot hachorep hen kemo shennitbaer), vekol mah sheepshar lehadder achar mayim qarim beyoter mehadderin. Abal keshehanneharot gedolot mehapsharat shelagim ugeshamim — tob yoter lishob min habbeerot im epshar, lepi shemme haggeshamim ume hapsharat shelagim hen rotechin yoter mimme habbeerot:

Me habbeerot umearot umartepot tzerikin gam ken tzinnun layla echad qodem hallisha, shehare hen maalin hebel bimot haggeshamim, vime nisan adayin mimot haggeshamim hen. Abal me haddut, dehaynu bor shehu merutztzap bebinyan beqarqaito ubeqirotayv sabib vehammayim shebbetoko hen kemunnachin beteba — yesh omerim shemmuttar lalush bahem bo bayyom shennishabu, lepi shechamimut me habbeerot vehabborot bimot hachorep eno ella mechamat shehachamma mehalleket az beshippulo shel raqia samuk laaretz veal yede ken mitchammem kol gup haaretz im hammayim shebbetokah, ella shehaavir sheal gabbe haaretz hu qar umeqarer gam ken miqtzat obi haaretz milmala, abal gup haaretz millematta hu cham bimot hachorep yoter mibbimot hachamma, ulekak gam hammayim shellematta hen chammin meat, abal hammayim shebbaddut shehabbinyan mapsiq ben haaretz lammayim mikkol tzedadehem — en chom hachamma maggia alehem, ulekak en tzarik lehalinam qodem hallisha. Umikkol maqom, en lismok al sebara zo ki im bishat haddechaq, shehare enenu root shemmayim hallalu bimot hachorep hem chammim kemo me beer:

Im abar velash issa bemayim shello lanu — asur leoklah bepesach, sheqqenasuhu chakamim, vehechemiru biqnas zeh leosrah al kol adam miyyisrael, kede shello yapritzu bazeh. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshellash bemezid, abal im lash beshogeg — lo qenasuhu chakamim, umuttar leoklo bepesach:

Bishat haddechaq shei epshar lo leqayyem mitzvat akilat matztza ella im ken yalush bemayim shello lanu, kegon shei epshar lo limtzo mayim shellanu, vegam i epshar lo limtzo matztza acheret, vegam i epshar lo lehamtin millalush ad sheyyishab mayim vilinem, kegon shehu ereb pesach — muttar lo lalush lekattechilla bemayim shello lanu, kede leqayyem mitzvat akilat matztza shehu min hattora. (Umikkol maqom, im epshar tob lishob mayim beereb pesach beben hashshemashot shel lel yom tob, veyalush bahem miyyad bitchillat hallayla, shehare yesh omerim shemmayim hallalu hem chashubim kemayim shellanu, kemo shennitbaer lemala):

Apillu mayim shellanu, im nitchammemu meat ad shennaasu posherin, dehaynu kachamimut haroq — en lashin bahem, ben shehayu samuk laesh venitchammemu meat mechom haesh, ben sheamedu bachamma ad shennitchammemu meat, ben shehiknisan letok keli shehaya omed al haesh vehurad veshahu betoko ad shennitchammemu meat, kegon shehiknisan letok dud gadol shel nechoshet o shel cheres leachar shehoriduhu meal haesh, umechamat shehashshulayim shello abeh vehu omed tamid al haesh hu meshammer et chummo, umechammem et hammayim hannishpakim leshulayv ap leachar shehoriduhu meal haesh:

Happosherin shennitztannenu — muttar lalush bahem. Abal hachammin shennitztannenu — yesh oserin lalush bahen im nitchammemu mechamat chom haesh, sheen tzinnun moil lechamme haur. Veyesh choleqin umattirin. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq o behepsed merubbeh, kegon sheabar velash bahem matztzot harbeh bemezid. Abal im lash beshogeg, apillu lash bechammin — yesh mattirin baakila (raq sheyyizzaher laasoq bah bizrizut yetera kemo shennitbaer lemala), shello qanesu al hashshogeg. Veyesh oserin baakila apillu lash beshogeg beposherin, velo mishshum qenas, ella mishshum chashash chimmutz, shekkeshennillosha beposherin hi memaheret lehachmitz. Veken iqqar (umikkol maqom, bishat haddechaq yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehattir baakila im lash beshogeg). Abal bahanaa o lehashhot ad leachar happesach — muttar ledibre hakkol, apillu lash bechammin bemezid:

Mayim shello lanu, apillu hen posherin, vaapillu hen chammin, im nitarebu berob mayim shellanu tzonenin — muttar lalush bahen lekattechilla, im enan posherin akshayv. Vaapillu lekattechilla nohagin hetter leareb mayim shello lanu berob mayim shellanu, veen zeh kimbattel issur lekattechilla, lepi shemmah shemmuttar lalush bahem leachar shennitarebu eno mechamat shehammayim shello lanu nitbattelu berob, ella mechamat shennitztannenu berob mayim shellanu shehen tzonenin, veap lekattechilla muttar letzannenan. Veap sheyyesh choleqin al zeh veoserin leareb beyadayim, mikkol maqom en limchot beyad hamqillin kassebara harishona (abal leatzmo tob lehachamir velachosh ledibre hammachamirin im epshar beqal limtzo od mayim shellanu, o sheepshar beqal lalush beyom acher qodem happesach bemayim shellanu):

Nohagin shello litten melach tok issat hammatztza. Venakon haddabar, lepi sheyyesh omerim shehammelach mechammem et haissa, shehare hammaliach hu keroteach veal yede ken haissa nocha lehachmitz. Veod, sheyyesh omerim shehammelach dino keme perot, shekkeshehem meorabin beissa shennillosha bemayim hi memaheret lehachmitz, dehaynu shehaeseq sheoseqin bah beyadayim eno matztzil otah mide chimmutz, ulepikak en lah taqqana ella leepotah tekep umiyyad shennitarebu me happerot betokah, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b:

Veim abar venatan bah meat melach (venillosh hammelach betokah shei epshar lahasiro mimmenna) — yopenna miyyad. Veen chosheshin shemma nitchammema haissa min hammelach, lepi sheyyesh omerim shemmeat melach en lo koach lechammem haissa, shehare hammaliach eno keroteach ella im ken hu maluach harbeh ad sheeno neekal mechamat milcho, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"a ayyen sham. Veim lo apaah miyyad — yesh lehachamir uleosrah baakila. Veap sheyyesh omerim shehammelach en lo din me perot veken iqqar kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b, mikkol maqom hare yesh omerim sheap meat melach mechammem et haissa veoserah:

Veim haissa hi nillosha beme perot bilbad, ap al pi shello apaah miyyad — mutteret, apillu natan bah melach harbeh ad sheenah yekola leheakel mechamat milchah, sheap im nitchammema enah baa lide chimmutz, kevan shennillosha beme perot. Abal lekattechilla yesh lehachamir kedibre haomerim shello litten melach baissa kelal apillu meat (vaapillu nillosha beme perot[)], lepi shehaiqqar hu shehammelach en lo din me perot ella din mayim, veissa shennillosha beme perot en leareb bah mayim lekattechilla apillu meat, apillu rotzeh leepotah miyyad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ts"b:

Veken yizzaher lekattechilla shello litten shum tablin baissa (shennillosha bemayim), lepi shehen charipin qetzat umechammemin qetzat et haissa. Veim abar unetanan betokah — mutteret. Abal im natan betokah pilpelin, apillu qoret echad pilpelin shennillosh betok haissa — yesh lehachamir uleosrah kullah baakila, lepi sheppilpel hu charip meod umechammem et kol haissa. Abal zangebil vekarkom veneglik, dinam kishar tablin sheenam oserin bediabad. Abal qetzach veshumshemin vekayyotze bahem mimmine zeraim sheen bahem chariput kelal — apillu lekattechilla muttar leorbam betok haissa (ella shellekattechilla yesh lekotsham qodem sheyyesimem baissa, veal yesimem betokah keshehem shelemim, mittaam sheyyitbaer besop siman t"s ayyen sham):

Umikkol maqom, hammatztza shel mitzva sheadam yotze bah yede chobato — tzarik shello yehe bah raq qemach umayim bilbad. Abal im ereb bah qetzach veshumshemin o mine tablin — hare zo matztza ashira, veeno yotze bah, ulepikak muttar leoklah beereb pesach (ayyen siman ta"a). Abal im abar venatan bah melach — enah niqret ashira mechamat hammelach shebbah, shehare gam heani noten melach baissa, lepikak asur leoklah beereb pesach. Veyesh omerim sheap im ereb bah mine tablin harbeh enah niqret matztza ashira bishbil kak, kevan sheiqqar asiyyatah, dehaynu lishat haqqemach eno ella bemayim bilbad. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir beshel tora kassebara harishona shehi niqret matztza ashira, veap al pi ken asur leoklah beereb pesach, sheyyesh lachosh al sebara hab' sheenah niqret matztza ashira (ki ken nireh iqqar):

Im napal meat sid betok haissa venillosh betokah — yesh lehachamir uleosrah baakila, shehassid mechammem otah umemaheret lehachmitz. Abal im napal aleha velo nillosh betokah — yesirennu mimmenna umutteret. Veken im napelu aleha pilpelin velo nilloshu betokah — yesirem mimmenna umutteret. Veap im nilloshu bah pilpelin vesid o melach harbeh — enah asura ella baakila, abal lo bahanaa, veken muttar lehashhotam ad leachar happesach, shehare apillu im lashah bechamme haur enah asura ella baakila bilbad, kemo shennitbaer lemala:
